events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day, we mark the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped 57 years ago today, giving us that legendary zebra crossing shot. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude made The Pretenders rock legends. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo success, his voice is unmistakable. What's your top Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless single 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – a song that still resonates globally with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? It changed everything for music lovers on the go. What was your first MP3 player?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring music of John Lennon. His impact on music and culture remains immeasurable. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us countless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album,' was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Beatles' Eclectic Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, diverse masterpiece that showed every facet of their genius. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we commemorate the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Legendary Performer Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. His legacy continues to rock the world. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Beatles Album
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul,' an album that marked a significant artistic shift and influenced countless musicians. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On this sombre day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose message of peace and love continues to resonate. His music lives on. What's his most impactful song for you?
